text: Pasted images are now stored content-addressed under `sessions/<id>/images/` and linked from their prompt via `data.images`, with normalizer v5 so an image no longer becomes a fake `[image]` turn. The engine serves them at `/api/sessions/:id/images/:file`, the reader shows thumbnails, `resume.ts` re-embeds them, and `images.keep` / `images.max_bytes` in config control storage; 57 tests pass, typecheck is clean, and the reader was checked in a browser, committed as d4f74f9 (unpushed) after an accidental sweep of another session's auto-reload edits in `server.ts` was undone.
